movement-beta.note:
A word on movement. Movement and the automation around it (Overwatch, Engagement, reactions on move, boost split, etc.) hooks into Foundry's v13 move pipeline. The multi step stacks (Boost & Move, Overcharge & Boost & Move) advance on onMove / onActivation, which fire post commit, so each leg has settled before the next one runs.

It's only medium stable though, so a few caveats:

  • Be wary on very vertical maps: heavy climbing / hover / big elevation deltas can throw off the cost math, and the longer chains (3 leg Overcharge path) have the most surface to misbehave.
  • If a stack stalls or a leg lands wrong, fall back to Ignore on the choice card, or hold the free movement key for a single drag.
  • For purely measuring (no token follow, no cost), Ctrl+drag from any empty hex gives you the vanilla ruler.

Predictive / multi waypoint dragging is still beta. If you hit weirdness, splitting the move into two drags usually unblocks it.

aided.description: You can STABILIZE as a quick action.

blinded.description: Your line of sight is 1 space.

brace.description: You resist the triggering attack. Until the end of your next turn, other attacks on you get +1 difficulty and you can't take reactions. On that turn you only get one quick action: no OVERCHARGE, standard move, full or free actions.

bulwark.description: You count as hard cover and block line of sight.

climber.description: You ignore the extra cost of climbing.

datalinked.description: Everyone sees all your stats, current values included.

dazed.description: Mechs only. You can only take one quick action: no OVERCHARGE, standard move, full or free actions, or reactions.

disengage.description: You ignore engagement and don't provoke reactions when you move.

falling.description: Falling 3+ spaces without recovering deals 3 Kinetic AP per 3 spaces, max 9. You fall 10 spaces per round, not at all in zero-G or very low G. Falling is involuntary movement.

grappled.description: You are held in a grapple: you are ENGAGED and can't take reactions.

grappling.description: You hold someone in a grapple: you are ENGAGED and can't take reactions.

guardian.description: Adjacent allies can use you as hard cover.

hover.description: You hover above the ground and move as if Flying.

infection.description: Like Burn, but Heat. You take Heat equal to the Infection received, and it stacks. End of your turn: a SYSTEMS check clears it, or take Heat equal to it. Whatever clears Burn (like STABILIZE) clears it too.

overheated.description: No actions or abilities that inflict Heat on you, including OVERCHARGE and HEAT X (SELF) systems. Weapons lose OVERKILL. STABILIZE clears it.

phasing.description: You can move through characters but can't end your move on them.

resistance_all.description: Resistance to all damage, burn and heat: take half, rounded up.

surefoot.description: You ignore difficult terrain, but not dangerous terrain.

terrain_immunity.description: You ignore difficult and dangerous terrain.

throttled.description: Your attacks deal half damage, heat and burn.

statusShort.DeadRings_statuses_vulnerable: A hostile can consume it on a hit for +1d6 bonus damage.
statusShort.bolster: +2 accuracy on your next skill check or save before the end of your next turn. Only one BOLSTER at a time.
statusShort.burn: It stacks. End of your turn: an ENGINEERING check clears it all, or take Burn damage equal to it.
statusShort.cascading: One of your NHPs is cascading. SHUT DOWN stabilises it.
statusShort.cover_hard: Ranged attacks against you get +2 difficulty.
statusShort.cover_soft: Ranged attacks against you get +1 difficulty.
statusShort.dangerzone: Half or more of your heat is filled in. This enables some attacks, talents and effects.
statusShort.downandout: Pilots only. You are unconscious and STUNNED, and any more damage kills you. You regain consciousness and half your HP when you rest.
statusShort.engaged: While adjacent to a hostile, your ranged attacks get +1 difficulty. If a target of equal or greater SIZE engages you during a move, you stop and lose any unused movement.
statusShort.exposed: Kinetic, explosive and energy damage you take is doubled, before reductions. STABILIZE clears it.
statusShort.flying: You move in three dimensions. If you don't move at least 1 space on your turn, you fall.
statusShort.hidden: Hostile attacks and actions can't target you, you don't cause engagement, and enemies only know your rough location. Attacking, forcing a save, a reaction, BOOST or losing cover ends it once resolved. SEARCH finds you.
statusShort.immobilized: You can't move voluntarily. Involuntary moves still work.
statusShort.impaired: +1 difficulty on all your attacks, saves and skill checks.
statusShort.intangible: You move through characters and terrain but can't end your turn in them. You, your actions and your effects only interact with INTANGIBLE characters and objects, both ways, and tangible characters can pass through you. You aren't adjacent to tangible characters and don't count for sitrep points or zones. Effects already on you stay, ongoing ones like traps or force fields end. Your pilot is INTANGIBLE too.
statusShort.invisible: Every attack against you, of any type, has a 50% chance to miss outright, before the roll. You can always HIDE, even without cover.
statusShort.jammed: No comms, no reactions, no tech actions or their benefits, and no attacks except IMPROVISED ATTACK, GRAPPLE and RAM.
statusShort.lockon: A hostile can consume it for +1 accuracy on its next attack against you. Some talents and systems need it.
statusShort.overshield: Takes damage before your HP. It doesn't stack, the highest applies.
statusShort.prone: Attacks against you get +1 accuracy. You are SLOWED and move as in difficult terrain. Stand up instead of your standard move, unless IMMOBILIZED. Standing up isn't movement and doesn't trigger OVERWATCH.
statusShort.resistance_burn: You take half burn, rounded up.
statusShort.resistance_energy: You take half Energy damage, rounded up.
statusShort.resistance_explosive: You take half Explosive damage, rounded up.
statusShort.resistance_heat: You take half heat, rounded up.
statusShort.resistance_kinetic: You take half Kinetic damage, rounded up.
statusShort.shredded: You don't benefit from ARMOR or RESISTANCE.
statusShort.shutdown: On shut down: heat is cleared, EXPOSED ends, cascading NHPs are stabilised, and statuses from tech actions (like LOCK ON) end. You are immune to all tech, allied included, and STUNNED until it ends. Nothing can prevent this.
statusShort.slow: Your only movement is your standard move, on your own turn. No BOOST, and no special moves from talents, systems or weapons.
statusShort.stunned: Mechs only. No OVERCHARGE, movement or actions, free actions and reactions included. EVASION max 5, and HULL and AGILITY checks and saves fail. Your pilot can still MOUNT, DISMOUNT or EJECT and acts normally.

content.theAdvancedStuffAndOneOf: The advanced stuff, and one of the core features of the Lancer Automations engine. Many many things go through here: accuracy, damage on next attack, immunities, rerolls, target modifiers. They inject into the regular Lancer system cards seamlessly. Read doc/API_EFFECTS.md for the full menu.
content.theBonusTypeEachOneReveals: The bonus type. Each one reveals its own fields below.
content.theEditorSuggestsApiNamesAs: The editor suggests API names as you type. Press Alt-Enter to open the list, then arrow through to see what each does.
content.theFxSectionStatusVisualEffects: The FX section: status visual effects (glows, shaders) plus the extra statuses I added. A bit like Lancer QoL, so pick one or the other if both are on.
content.theLAButtonOpensThis: The L.A button opens this menu. Add Effect opens the Effect Manager for this sheet, Add Extra attaches actions/deployables/bars, and Extra Config (items only) tunes auto-consume and deployable range/count.
content.theLancerAutomationsTokenActionHud: The Lancer Automations Token Action HUD - your token's action menu.
content.theMenuColumnListsCategoriesActions: The Menu column lists categories (Actions, Weapons, Systems, Frame, Talents, Utility, Statuses). Hovering or clicking a row cascades extra columns out to the right.
content.theRightNumberIsTheMax: The right number is the max move this turn (speed); the left is what the token has used so far. Boost (or anything granting extra move) extends the cap.
content.theStandardEffectPagePickA: The standard effect page. Pick a status, a duration, optionally an auto-consume trigger.
content.thereIsALotMoreUnder: There is a lot more under the hood, but the tour would get long. Drop by Discord if you have questions.
content.tickTheTriggersThatFireIt: Tick the triggers that fire it: onMove, onHit, onActivation, onStructure, and many more.
content.tokenActionHudIsOffEnable: Token Action HUD is off. Enable it for the tour?
content.unlockWithTheLockIconThen: Unlock with the lock icon, then drag the HUD anywhere. The reset icon restores its position.
content.visionFromEdgeForBigTokens: Vision-from-edge for big tokens, the Lancer Sensors and Battlefield Awareness detection modes (auto-add, combat-only, range source), basic-sight overrides, and drag-vision behavior all live here.
content.whatHappensWhenSomethingDiesSpawn: What happens when something dies. Spawn a wreck token, play the explosion, optionally drop terrain. Per-category if you want monstrosity wrecks to look different from mech wrecks.
content.whereYouBuildAutomationsItemBound: Where you build automations. Item-bound (per LID) or general, code-driven, fired on triggers like onMove, onHit, onActivation, and so on.
content.yourActivationsGroupedIntoFoldersEach: Your activations, grouped into folders. Each row binds to one or more triggers and runs your code.
content.yourLogicEvaluateShouldItFire: Your logic: evaluate (should it fire?), activation (what happens), plus onInit and onMessage.

tour.placeTokenSubtitle: The TAH tour needs a mech token.
tour.resumeBody: You can re-launch this tour later from Configure Settings > Module Settings > Lancer Automations > Tour, or from Foundry's Configure Tours menu.
tour.resumeSubtitle: Take the tour now or later.
tour.theAdvancedMeasureToolShapesRanges: The Advanced Measure tool: shapes, ranges, markers, and shortcuts.
tour.theGameplayToolsInsideTheToken: The gameplay tools inside the Token Action HUD: skirmish/barrage, boost, deploy, contest, scan, link, reinforcement, downtime, reserve, vote.
tour.theMovementWheelMovementTypesAnd: The movement wheel, movement types, and the free/debug keys.
tour.walksThroughTheActivationManagerDialog: Walks through the Automation Manager dialog (custom activations, defaults, startup scripts).
tour.walksThroughTheEffectManagerDialog: Walks through the Effect Manager dialog (standard, custom, bonus, manage).
